subject.statement: Do Kwon was arrested in Montenegro and extradited to South Korea.

summary: Do Kwon was arrested by Montenegrin authorities at Podgorica airport in March 2023. After a court process, Montenegro approved his extradition to South Korea, and he was handed over to South Korean officials in early 2024.
